contracts.signReadme:
Digital signature: {{file}}
=======================================

1. Install Java (if you do not have it yet) and download JSignPdf: http://jsignpdf.sourceforge.net/
2. Run from this folder (Windows, cmd/PowerShell):

   {{command}}

   -kst WINDOWS-MY = reads the certificate from the Windows certificate store (certSIGN,
   virtual token); when it runs, JSignPdf/Windows asks for the token PIN.
   -llx/-lly/-urx/-ury/-page = the position of the rectangle picked in the app (PDF coordinates, points).

3. The result is "semnat_{{file}}". Upload it back with the button
   "I signed it, upload the PDF" in the Sign tab.

If JSignPdf does not find the certSIGN certificate in -kst WINDOWS-MY, your virtual token does not
expose its private key outside the provider's own app. Sign by hand in Adobe Acrobat as before
and upload the result here anyway, so it stays in the document's history.
